qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Media-buying scale and legacy agency-of-record relationships have been systematically disintermediated by platform self-serve tools (Google, Meta, Amazon) and client in-housing. Historical GAAP ROIC of 6–8% (dropping to ~3% in 2023) is far below the 12% hurdle, with negative pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% & negative pricing power, REJECT). WPP suffers from a multi-decade rollup legacy burdened with goodwill, generating sub-8% multi-year median GAAP ROIC. Media-buying scale advantages have eroded as clients build internal marketing teams, switch to programmatic self-serve platforms, and demand fee reductions.
qualitative.evidence: WPP reported ROIC of 11.4% (2022), 3.4% (2023), and ~8-10% (2024), yielding a 5-year median well below 10%. Operating margins lag top peers at 11–14%. Ongoing marquee account re-pitches, fee deflation, and restructuring charges highlight the lack of economic moat and absence of above-inflation pricing power.
